description: Optional add-on to commandguard_command / commandguard_sql, for when a human should decide instead of the agent just stopping: checks one shell command or SQL statement and, if it is warned or blocked, sends the owner a one-tap approve/deny link (ntfy, Slack, Discord, webhook or link only) via AskHuman. Returns the check plus approval_url, poll_url and wait_url; execute only when status is approved (no answer = deny). Paid x402 $0.03 USDC on Base per call, including when no approval is needed; for the check alone use commandguard_command ($0.001).

ask_on.description: Verdicts that trigger a human request (default block, warn)

command.description: Shell command to check (send command or sql)

sql.description: SQL to check (send command or sql)

name: commandguard_check_and_approve
